warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning - Southeast Queensland for Sunshine Coast, Gold Coast, Scenic Rim, Somerset, Moreton Bay
warnings.desc: The Bureau of Meteorology warns that, at 1:35 pm, severe thunderstorms likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding were detected near Toogoolawah, Moore, the NSW border, Mapleton and Linville. These thunderstorms are moving towards the east to northeast. They are forecast to affect the McPherson Range, Springbrook and Lake Somerset by 1:50 pm and Numinbah Valley, Little Nerang Dam and Somerset Dam by 2:05 pm.
